# unifi_spatial_record (Resource)

The `unifi_spatial_record` resource manages a spatial record in the UniFi controller: a named set of devices placed at x/y/z coordinates within a mapped space, used to describe the physical layout of access points.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A spatial record placing access points at x/y/z coordinates within a mapped space.
resource "unifi_spatial_record" "floor_1" {
  name = "Floor 1 layout"

  devices = [
    {
      mac = "aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff"
      position = {
        x = 12.5
        y = 4.0
        z = 3.0
      }
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `devices` (Attributes List) The devices placed within this spatial record. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))
- `name` (String) The name of the spatial record (1–128 characters).
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Optional:

- `mac` (String) The MAC address of the placed device.
- `position` (Attributes) The x/y/z position of the device within the mapped space. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices--position))

<a id="nestedatt--devices--position"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices.position`

Optional:

- `x` (Number) The X coordinate.
- `y` (Number) The Y coordinate.
- `z` (Number) The Z coordinate.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# import from provider configured site
terraform import unifi_spatial_record.floor_1 5dc28e5e9106d105bdc87217

# import from another site
terraform import unifi_spatial_record.floor_1 another-site:5dc28e5e9106d105bdc87217
```
